notes.title: Colored Keys and Locks, Controller Support and more!
notes.content:
Our [b]April Update[/b] is here! This update brings Colored Keys to the game as well as full controller support! We also have some other enhancements and bug fixes, check out the notes below for more details.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Colored Keys and Locks[/b] - We added Red, Blue, and Green keys to the game as well as similarly colored locks and Key Blocks! Now you have even greater control when designer your dungeon and granting access to different rooms
[*][b]Key Block Linking[/b] - We added the ability to link from a Key Block! Now when a Key Block is unlocked and destroyed, a link can trigger
[*][b]Linking to Tree[/b] - We added the ability to link to the Large Tree and Dead Large Tree. Linking to it makes it shake and drop its item.
[*][b]Linking from Tree[/b] - We also added the ability to link from the Large Tree and Dead Large Tree. This link will trigger when the tree shakes. You can shake the tree more than once to keep triggering the link. Reminder that Bombs and Scuttleswine both shake trees!
[/list]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Full Controller Support[/b] - We updated our plugin and added the following enhancements
[*][b]Connect/Disconnect Warning[/b] - An on-screen popup warns you when a controller connects or disconnects
[*][b]Game Pauses on Disconnect[/b] - If an actively used controller disconnects the game will now pause
[*][b]Broader Controller Support[/b] - We updated our plugin to support more controller types. Let us know if your favorite controller still needs to be supported!
[*][b]Proper Startup Initialization[/b] - Previously we weren't properly initializing our controller plugin which was leading to inconsistent success with controller usage
[*][b]Descriptive Controller Names[/b] - The controller names in the Settings menu are now more descriptive when using Steam input
[*][b]On-Screen Keyboard[/b] - An on-screen keyboard now appears when selecting an input field while in Steam's Big Picture mode. This also works with Steam Deck!
[*][b]Multi-Controller Menu Navigation[/b] - Any connected controller can now be used for menus and build mode (previously only player 1 could control the cursor)
[*][b]Double Cursor Bug[/b] - Fixed issue where occasionally both hardware and virtual cursors are shown
[*][b]Ammo Selection Bug[/b] - Fixed Starting Equipment ammo selection not showing for controllers
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Room Corner Arrows now properly align[/b] - When all four corners of four rooms met one of them was a little unaligned
[*][b]Repainting Bug[/b] - Fixed a bug where repainting over an object would affect what Group it was in
[*][b]Mod.io Bug[/b] - Fixed a mod.io error when playing dungeons from Online Dungeons
[*][b]Shield Bug[/b] - Fixed a bug where using the Shield caused errant button prompt pop-ups
[*][b]MTO Bug[/b] - Fixed bug related to moving multi-tile long objects onto other objects
[*][b]Group Menu[/b] - The Group Menu now updates properly when hitting undo to remove an object from a group
[*][b]Well bug[/b] - Fixed an issue where the player would fall into a pit after using a Well instead of spawning on a safe adjacent tile
[*][b]Rugs under Inner Walls[/b] - Fixed rugs and interior walls not playing nice together
[*][b]Search Results[/b] - Fixed search results not displaying correctly when returning to online dungeons after/while playing a dungeon
[*][b]Triangle Block Undo Bug[/b] - Fixed an issue where the Triangle Block rotations were not saved when using the rotate button, leading to issues with undo history after that
[*][b]Scuttleswine[/b] - Scuttleswine no longer shakes the screen when knocked into a wall
[*][b]Starting Equipment Weapon Slot Bug[/b] - Fixed an issue where the weapon slot window allowed the player to interact with the dungeon behind it
[*][b]Button Prompt Bubble Expanded[/b] - The Button Prompt Bubble (above doors, chests, signs, etc.) now expands to fit the full name of the key the player needs to press to interact
[*][b]Button Prompt Bubble Position[/b] - We also moved the Button Prompt Bubble to appear closer to the lock and it no longer rotates sideways for left/right facing doors for better readability
[*][b]Max Ammo Bug[/b] - Fixed a bug where the ammo set in the Starting Equipment window was carrying over between building different dungeons
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Startup Sequence[/b] - Fixed an issue where game audio sometimes did not start
[*][b]Flying Razor Trap[/b] - Added SFX to the Flying Razor Trap propellers
[*][b]Multiplayer Checkpoint[/b] - Fixed a bug where the Activate Checkpoint SFX was not playing for each player
[*][b]Snap Trap[/b] - Fixed an issue where deleting the Snap Trap in build mode was not playing its dying SFX
[/list]

We can't wait to see how you'll use the Colored Keys in your dungeons. Thanks for your continued support as we stay hard at work bringing more content to the game!

notes.title: March 2025 Update: Cracked Floor, Fire Lizarc, Flying Razor Traps and more!
notes.content:
Our [b]March update[/b] is here! This update includes a handful of new objects and enhancements as well as many bug fixes.
[list]
[*][b]Cracked Floor Tile[/b] - Cracked Floor Tiles will crumble away as soon as you step off of them and turn into a pit. Leaving a room and re-entering will restore them. Linking from a Cracked Floor Tile will trigger the link when the tile crumbles. Linking to a Cracked Floor Tile will restore that tile when triggering the link. Note that if you link to a Cracked Floor Tile, it will no longer restore when leaving and re-entering a room.
[*][b]Fire Lizarc[/b] - A new enemy variant has appeared! This yellow Lizarc wearing a red hood is even deadlier than his green counterpart. The Fire Lizarc shoots Fire Arrows which can be used to light torches. The Fire Lizarc also moves faster and the arrows it shoots travel faster than a normal arrow.
[*][b]Flying Razor Traps[/b] - A new variant of the Razor Traps is here: the Flying Razor Trap! Flying Razor Traps come in the same Red and Blue variants as the standard Razor Trap. A Flying Razor Trap can fly over pits and won't trigger cracked floor tiles like the regular Razor Traps do!
[*][b]Inactive Razor Traps[/b] - You can now place Inactive Razor Traps in build mode. Previously, only the active versions were placeable. Link to an Inactive Razor Trap to turn it on.
[*][b]Camera Bounds in Build Mode[/b] - When building a dungeon the camera will stop moving once a room is at the very edge of the screen. No more getting lost in the build void!
[*][b]Starting Equipment Menu Overhaul[/b] - The Starting Equipment Menu has been overhauled! It's now much easier to specify the minimum number of players you want for your dungeon. We also added a section to let the player start with "Upgrades" such as the Dash Boots or Map/Monocular. More Upgrades will come in time! The "Shared Inventory" button is now a toggle button and when it's active you can only edit/access Player 1's inventory which now says "All Players" instead of "P1".
[*][b]Featured Dungeons[/b] - We removed the "Popular Dungeons" tab in Online Dungeons and replaced it with "Featured Dungeons". This will be a curated list of dungeons that we'll spotlight from time to time. Dungeons from our Designer Challenges will often appear here.
[*][b]View all of a Designer's uploaded dungeons[/b] - It's now possible to view all of the dungeons uploaded by a particular Designer. When browsing a dungeon, click on the thumbnail, then click on the Designer's name or icon to see a list of all of their uploaded dungeons.
[*][b]New Loading Screens[/b] - New loading screens were added, it's random which one you'll see. Now loading is fun!
[*][b]Transparent Switch now placeable over pits! [/b] - Now you can trigger links as you fall to your doom!
[*][b]Dungeon Thumbnails hide more info[/b] - Previously, Dungeon Thumbnails were showing a bit too much info (hidden links, stack quantities, Door Lines and Labels, etc.). Well, it doesn't anymore!
[*][b]Spawner Linking Update[/b] - Grouped Spawners were not triggering links properly. Now all spawners in the group will need to have been activated and will need to have everything they spawned picked up or defeated before they trigger their link. Once cleared, the link repeats as expected, requiring the player to clear both spawners. We'll be further enhancing this in the future with a visible marking on a spawner if it has been cleared.
[*][b]Fireflies bug[/b] - Wait, fireflies ARE bugs, what's the problem here? Well, they were breaking links. Fireflies placed on linked objects no longer cause issues with links working.
[/list]

Phew! We're excited to see how you use these new tools to create amazing dungeons. Thank you all for your continued support and for inspiring us to keep going!

notes.title: Shield, Razor Traps, Spiked Block, and Conveyors!
notes.content:
We have a hefty surprise update with a few exciting new objects to play with!

Update Notes
[list]
[*] Shield: A new usable tool, use the shield to block damage in front of you. You'll strafe while the Shield is out and you'll also move slower.

[*] Razor Traps: There are two versions, a Blue Razor Trap that automatically moves up/down or left/right until it hits something, and a Red Razor Trap that will fly at the player when they step in front of it. Finally, a full tile wide moving hazard!

[*] Spiked Block: A block covered in spikes so the player takes damage when touching it. The spikes can be retracted via linking. There are also push-able variants that can only be pushed when the spikes are retracted.

[*] Conveyors: We have basic conveyors added in the objects menu, we are still deciding what objects will be moveable on conveyors. So far they will move all items, enemies, blocks and some other objects. In our next update we'll be adding linking to the conveyors as well as a switch to toggle them on and off. Stay tuned for more updates! We're excited to see what puzzles come out of these.
[/list]

notes.title: The Forest Theme is here in our first big update!
notes.content:
A brand new theme has been added to the game - The Forest Theme! Click the tree icon in the top right build mode menu to check out all the new materials. There are also new tutorials to help you navigate the theme. Please leave us your feedback or suggestions!

[b]This was a large update, here's a full list of everything available[/b]
[list]
[*]The Forest Theme is now available! This includes over 100+ new materials and dark/light color variations.
[*]A new tutorial was added for "Themes".
[*]A new tutorial was added for "The Forest Theme", won't you help Scout touch grass?
[*]Select the music that plays in your dungeon! From the Dungeon Options menu you can select a track and click the "Set Music" button to have that music play during your dungeon. You can also preview the tracks by clicking on them in this menu.
[*]Three new music themes were added that can be selected as described in the previous bullet: "Forest - Light", "Forest - Dark" and we put the "Classic" theme back in the game in case you missed it. You missed it, didn't you?
[*]Many updates to SFX such as all new Forest Theme SFX, various Build SFX, Spikes retracting, making the bomb fuse loop and "Triangle Blocks sound less pingy" (which is official composer lingo).
[*]Player footstep SFX for walking on different materials such as grass, dirt, grates, bridges and more!
[*]The Yellow Gooey is here to ZAP YOU! The Yellow Gooey is a new Gooey variant that moves faster and zaps the player on contact. The Yellow Gooey will also zap the player if they use their sword on it. Pro tip: try stunning it with the Frog Glove first!
[*]Tooltips were updated on a handful of objects including all Wall tiles to include the keyboard shortcut for flipping a Wall.
[*]The Crate was added as a new décor material in the Castle Theme. The crate can hold an item and takes two sword hits to break.
[*]Tombstones and Fountain moved to the Forest Theme, signs moved to Objects, and skulls/pots moved to décor for the Castle and Forest themes respectively.
[*]Health values have been adjusted for a few enemies: Cardinal Sentry now have 4hp (four hits with the sword, or just 1 bomb!). Hopscorch has 3hp now (down from 5).
[*]A temporary "fill-replace" tool was added. Hold Ctrl + Left Click to replace all connected tiles of the same type with the tile you have selected. For example, if you have a complete Castle Theme wall around your room, you can select a Forest Canopy from the menu, then Ctrl + Left Click on the Castle Wall to replace the entire Wall with Forest Canopy walls in one click! We'll be adding and revamping tools at a later date - but wanted a temporary solution in place for the time being.
[*]Fix for spike layering in old dungeons (spikes were showing underneath some tiles in old dungeons due to a recent change).
[/list]
As always, thank you for your continued support! We value your feedback, please let us know what you think in the Steam Community forums for our page - or in our Discord channel.

We have more great updates in the works, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Notes for March 30th 2024 - 200 dungeons!
notes.content:
We have a handful of updates as well as many small bug fixes and enhancements! We'll have another big and exciting update coming soon. We also recently hit 200 dungeons in Browse Dungeons!!

[b]March 30th 2024 Update Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus Marker object - When you place an active Focus Marker in your dungeon, the camera will zoom out to keep the tile you placed the Focus Marker on always in the frame! You can link to Focus Markers to turn them on and off so it's a great way to show the player something just out of their view such as a treasure chest or a frog statue. There is an active and inactive version.
[*] Wall Stairs - Wall Stairs let the player go up and down walls. If you place walls in the middle of a room the player can now use Wall Stairs as a way to move in and out of that area. Projectiles will also go over Wall Stairs. Enemies will avoid the Wall Stairs so be wary of creating a "safe spot" for the player.
[*] Projectiles now travel over Scout's rug
[*] Autosave enhancements - We added a "restore autosave" button to each dungeon in the dungeon detail view of your "My Dungeons" page. This will replace the current autosave with the last autosave from that dungeon. If you happen to lose an autosave for a dungeon you were working on, you can restore it this way. Be careful, if you have an autosave of an unsaved dungeon you will lose it when you click this button!
[*] Tutorial Animations and Updates - We added animations to the tutorials under Dungeon Training. Scout has animations and the text will scroll onto the screen. You can also skip forward and backward through the tutorials. Two new tutorials were also added for Linking part 2 and Controls and Shortcuts.
[*] False Pitfalls now have colored variants - You can now change the color of the pit around a False Pitfall.
[*] Confirmation pop-ups - We added a confirmation box when you try to leave a dungeon you are playing to warn you that you will lose all progress.
[*] Various Bug Fixes and Enhancements
[/list]

Thanks as always for your continued support and for all of the amazing dungeons! We have a lot of exciting updates coming soon.

[b]How do I add an exit to my dungeon?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/85812fcda93e763caba1069670e470b02c5f86a1.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]How do Links work?[/b]
[list]
[*]Place down some objects you want to link then enter Link Mode by clicking the Hammer/Pencil icon in the bottom left. Click on the Magic Wand icon at the bottom of the screen so your cursor is set to link objects together (when you click on Link Mode it should set to that by default). Then, click on the object you want to trigger a link, then click on the object you want it to trigger. For example, if you click on a Bat enemy, then click on a Treasure Chest - they are officially linked! The Treasure Chest won't appear until the Bat is defeated. Links affect a lot of things in different ways but generally items/enemies will appear when linked to. Some objects will appear or change state when linked to. For example, the Spike Trap will spring up when linked to.
[/list]
[b]How do Groups work?[/b]
[list]
[*]Groups are used with linking so you can trigger multiple things at once. Click on a Group Color from the left side menu when in Link Mode. Then, click on any objects you want to add to that group. Now, when you link to or from one of the objects in that group, that link will affect the entire group. For example, if you link from the "Boss Splits In Two" icon to a Lizard enemy, the Lizard will spawn when the Boss Splits in two! (the Boss splits when hit 6 times). notes.content:
[b]Hey Dungeon Designers![/b]

Our Playtest is here! This post will serve as your one stop for anything and everything related to the Playtest.

[b]How do I access the Playtest?[/b]
[list]
[*]There is a link in the middle of our Store Page, after clicking that link you should have a game called "Super Dungeon Designer Playtest" in your Steam Library. If you signed up ahead of time, check your Steam Library!
[/list]
[b]Where can I learn how to play?[/b]
[list]
[*]Discovering how the game works can be fun, if you're having trouble figuring something out please reach out either by replying to this post or jumping into the Super Dungeon Designer [url=https://discord.gg/HGmfz9g]Discord Channel[/url] to ask. Every item has a tooltip, just hover your mouse over the item in the build menu to learn what it does!
[/list]
[b]What does this button do?[/b]
[list]
[*]Here is a UI cheatsheet:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/4b5a3a803430dd7620058fe802b6274bc43798db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/97810a6e7cde8d277d720d92029ccf5f10b67fdb.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Where can I report bugs or feature requests?[/b]
[list]
[*]Please report all bugs!! It will really help us out. You can report bugs by replying to this post, or in our Discord channel (link above). You can also email us at contact@squishstudios.net. If you have a feature request you can post that here, or create your own post in the forum to get a discussion going around it. We take feature requests seriously, if we see a lot of hype around a new feature we'll definitely consider it for the game.
[/list]
[b]How do I share my levels?[/b]
[list]
[*]Dungeon sharing is not fully implemented yet, but we did integrate with mod.io so you can download dungeons we upload. We'll be uploading dungeons players make during the Playtest. To get your dungeons uploaded you can drop your dungeon files into our Discord server or email them to us at contact@squishstudios.net. To find your dungeon files, navigate to "My Dungeons", click on your dungeon and click on the folder icon in the top left (image below). Zip up the three files there and send them our way! We'll make sure they get uploaded so others can find them from the "Browse Dungeons" menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/8357f4bbf958b6b1d7b7b423b66b68900870d4e2.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]How do I browse levels others uploaded?[/b]
[list]
[*]Click the "Browse Dungeons" button from the main menu. Click "Subscribe" to download any levels you want to try out! To play those levels, navigate back to the Main Menu and click on "My Dungeons". Note that the upload UI is not final.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/658d327cced9bb891f4040e7b93f81a7aa79e839.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]I can't install the game![/b]
[list]
[*]Reply to this post or jump in the Discord Channel and let us know what kind of error you're getting.
[/list]
[b]Will there be more playtests? What happens to the levels I make during this playtest?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes! There will be more playtests in the near future so keep an eye out! Unfortunately, we can't guarantee your levels will continue to function by the time the next playtest comes up. We're at a point in development where we're still making big changes to the core components of the game and sometimes that breaks old levels.
[/list]
[b]How do I play co-op?[/b]
[list]
[*]First, click on this button at the top of the left menu while building your dungeon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/4aaf51b90a3cfd34f165122d80c28099df9e70ee.png[/img]
Next, click on this button to add another player. Click it three times to add up to four players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/95250888817657486fbc8de0959895be5ae54e3f.png[/img]
Note that all players share equipment at the moment. That will be changed in a future update so each player has a separate inventory. By default, all players will start wherever you place Player 1. You can set individual start locations by selecting and placing players from the characters menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/ddb9bc5659531770d7b262a179de9a3f600bb97c.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]How do I play with a controller?[/b]
[list]
[*]Controllers should register even if you connect them while playing, we recommend syncing controllers to your computer before you start the game. Bring up the menu by hitting ESC and click on "Controls". From there you can assign controllers to different players and also remap any buttons you need to remap. You can also remap keyboard and mouse controls from this menu. 
[/list]
[b]How does Steam Remote Play Together work?[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam Remote Play Together is a Steam feature that we support. For more information check out this link: [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2]https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2[/url]
We recommend a strong internet connection, especially when you add more than 2 players.
[/list]
[b]How do I add an exit to my dungeon?[/b]
[list]
[*]Add an "End Level Tile" to add an exit to your dungeon. You can place multiple "End Level Tiles" and hide them or make them a part of a puzzle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/85812fcda93e763caba1069670e470b02c5f86a1.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]How do I add a locked/closed door?[/b]
[list]
[*]Many objects in the menu have a "cycle button" on the bottom right of their icon. Click this button to cycle through variations of the object. The Door object has three variations (open, closed, locked).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/9b75bf8e81b2eb4528f07f46c56995ac400e7c20.png[/img]
[/list]

This page will be updated throughout the playtest as more questions come up!

We're excited to build some dungeons with you!

-James

notes.title: Warthogs, flames, item pickup, music and enhancements!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Future Dungeon Designers![/b]

It's funny how time flies, we've been heads down working hard on the game and getting ready for our next convention. It has been some time since we last posted an update on our Steam page. I am going to try to post here more regularly, but rest assured we are hard at work.

If you haven't jumped in yet, join us in the Super Dungeon Designer Discord Channel! [url=https://discord.gg/cxcUPts]https://discord.gg/cxcUPts[/url]

One area that has been in need of some love is our UI. We have finished creating all of the art pieces for the new UI and I'm excited to share that with you soon. We'll be looking to get that implemented in the game very soon and I'll share another update when we do.

We recently brought on a composer to create custom music for the game. We'll be creating a new trailer soon with the new music and UI once they're both ready!

Now, let's get into some of the things we have added since our last update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/bb584858bd92cae6c33584ad3de1b52dd3be8bd0.gif[/img]
This is our Warthog enemy. Whenever the player is in front of him (standing in the same row or column as him) he will charge in a straight line towards the player and break any breakable objects in his path. This enemy could be a fun way to create some puzzles where you need the player to spawn a warthog via the linking system, then guide him towards a cracked wall to proceed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/477fcd90b42fb385485005f641d1725fb4467973.gif[/img]
A living flame! This new enemy will only move diagonally unless chasing the player and has no knockback when hit. The living flame will always jump towards the player if they are one tile away. If the living flame is one tile way from a torch, it will happily jump onto it and light it (and trigger any links the torch is set to, such as opening the door in this gif).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/08729413691ee997e7c05633957a065d1e4f5b9b.gif[/img]
Items now appear above the player's head for a second when picked up, making it easier to see what cool goodies you just snagged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/419e4518ca3bbb28a1b58bb6f542cf3acb0925e6.gif[/img]
Lastly, there is now a highlight box that follows your cursor when designing your dungeon. This makes figuring out where an object is going to be placed much more intuitive. It works for the bigger objects like the fountain too!

There have been lots of other little tweaks and some reworks on the backend as well. I'm hoping that once we get the new UI in we can do a Steam playtest with all of you so we can start incorporating your feedback into the game and squash some bugs together. I'm hopeful we'll be able to do that in the next couple months. Thank you for your patience as we continue to add-to and refine the game. We can't wait to see what puzzling and challenging levels come from the community as we begin designing dungeons together soon. Leave a comment here and let us know what feature you're looking forward to most.

- James
Squish Studios

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/a356e35f8d08f1a90d10b1d76b0dc9ad366dc97d.gif[/img]
Hello Everyone, 

We've made a lot of progress over the last few months so I wanted to share a big update showcasing where we're at and all of the exciting new features we have working. We will post more big updates here up through launch.

We're trying hard to build up a community right now so please Wishlist and if you want to be involved in development and stay up to date on play test opportunities, hop over to our Discord to chat with us!
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/HGmfz9g]https://discord.gg/HGmfz9g[/url]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list][*]We have up to 4 player Co-op working locally and online via Steam Remote Play Together! Dungeons can be saved and in the future labeled with the specific number of players needed to play them so you can make multiplayer dungeons that require players to work together to solve puzzles and complete them. The camera zooms out when players move away from each other, then turns to split screen when they get too far away. We're still refining this system, but we're so excited to have it working.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/NqL5LEkRamZV9rhCvd/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Full controller support while playing (not designing). This is especially helpful for local Co-op and so far we've found that most common controllers are compatible.

[*]Lots of new decorations: Bookshelf, fountain, tombstones, pillars, multi-colored carpet, grates, more floor tiles, breakable pots/skulls that items can be placed in.

[*]Teleport pads and staircases! Doors aren't the only way to transition rooms anymore.
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/lqwLKR0keM1RsUw9DP/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Boss door and Boss Key(gif in the header). The Boss Door can only be opened if the player uses a Boss Key. Bosses are coming soon!

[*]Gold Bow and Gold Bombs. These upgrades of the normal Bow/Bomb give the player unlimited Arrows/Bombs.

[*]Heart containers. Adds one heart to your total hearts.
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/nN9txV6VKWYpU8iyZm/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Statue enemy. The statue activates if the player gets too close. It shoots out fire balls in 4 directions that curve and follow the player.
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/utqrFtTDZASYKmY7ki/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Repeatable switches. We have repeatable switches for the Orb Switch and Floor Switch. Triggering these objects more than once will make any linked objects that can change states more than once do so. For example, if a Repeatable Floor Switch is linked to a Closed Door, the door will open when the player steps on it but close if they step off of it.
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/EAju8vTDXDPHqP3bmj/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Room creation and expansion enhancements. We made it so if a new room is created it has walls and floor tiles by default. Expanding a room also expands the wall/floor tiles making it easy to edit rooms on the fly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35991542/ad13f166d89cfca954aba12ac0c060f7d40e83f4.gif[/img]

[*]Lighting enhancements. We have dark rooms that get brighter as you light torches. We also added a glow to objects that light up like the statue enemy and the orb switch.

[*]Arrow traps. The player can add an arrow trap to a wall tile, arrows will shoot out of the trap every few seconds. These arrows can trigger Orb Switches so it's possible to create some cool timed events using Repeatable Orb Switches.

[*]Set starting health and collectibles. There is now a section to decide how many hearts the player starts with and if they start with any bombs/arrows/keys.
[/list]
I think that's everything. We are continuing to work passionately to make this game the best it can be. This game needs a strong community around it at launch in order to be successful so we want to do whatever we can to foster that community. Please come join us in [url=https://discord.gg/HGmfz9g]Discord[/url] and chat about what you would like to see in the game!

[b]What's coming next?[/b]
[list][*]A spoopy ghost!

[*]Updated UI

[*]Gold as a currency to collect

[*]An NPC with a shop where players can use their gold to buy items in a dungeon

[*]More enemies

[*]Bosses
[/list]
Much much more! We'll be having another limited time alpha test soon for anyone in our Discord channel so come join us if you want to play! Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted, we greatly appreciate your support and feedback. We can't wait to build and share some dungeons with you!

-Squish Studios
